build_annoy_index: build an Annoy approximate nearest neighbor index from a numpy array of feature vectors
save_annoy_index: save a built Annoy index to disk for later reuse
read_annoy_index: read a previously saved Annoy index from disk given feature dimensions
compute_neighbor_indices_and_distances: compute k-nearest neighbor indices and euclidean distances for all paper feature vectors using Annoy
run_neighbor_builder: run the neighbor builder CLI to build Annoy index and compute neighbors for paper embeddings
